notes: Supersedes 002 (methods + Florida transport) and 003 (theory update). Full old->corrected ledger: results/card_corrections.csv (28 rows).

Washington Panel A was NOT re-estimated (the audit verified it sound); it is reused unchanged. The recidivism headline is not re-estimated on new data (none exists). Branch N: both 0.15 codings carry equal standing.
Florida dedup works entirely from the existing 002 parquet shards (no fetch): rows map 1:1 to manifest rows; the 2nd occurrence of each of 5 duplicated files was dropped.

Item-4 limitation: a two-extractor field-level re-audit is impossible (raw PDFs deleted at ingest, no fetch); the closest version (in-parquet per-field validity on 30 dedup pages/yr; 99.44% n_valid_samples, readings all in [0,0.478]) was run instead.

003 fabricated sentence (in-sample appendix) named in card_corrections.csv; it was run for real and is directionally opposite what was claimed.
